messages.content: How can I sell my acoustic guitar?

function.name: tune_instrument
function.description: This function helps tune instruments based on the instrument type and the desired key or note. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

instrument_type.description: The type of the instrument, e.g. 'acoustic guitar', 'piano'.

key.description: The key or note to which the instrument should be tuned to. Default is 'Standard' for guitars.

message.content:
Here’s a step‑by‑step guide to help you get your acoustic guitar sold quickly and at a fair price: | Step | What to Do | Why It Matters | |------|------------|----------------| | **1. Clean & Tune** | Give the guitar a quick wash (soft cloth, mild cleaner) and tune it to standard pitch. | A well‑presented, properly tuned instrument looks more appealing and shows you’ve cared for it. | | **2. Take Quality Photos** | Capture the body, headstock, strings, fretboard, and any visible wear or damage. Use natural light and a neutral background. | Good photos attract buyers and reduce the chance of disputes over condition. | | **3. Write a Detailed Description** | Include brand, model, year, serial number, condition notes (e.g., “no cracks, minor fret wear”), and any accessories (case, strap). | Transparency builds trust and reduces returns or complaints. | | **4. Research Pricing** | Check recent sales on eBay, Reverb, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, and local music stores. | Pricing competitively increases chances of a sale while ensuring you don’t undersell. | | **5. Choose Your Selling Platform(s)** | • **Online Marketplaces** – eBay, Reverb, Etsy, Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace.
• **Local Consignment Shops** – Many music stores will hold and sell for a commission.
• **Social Media Groups** – Local buy/sell groups on Facebook or Reddit’s r/GuitarSwap.
• **Specialized Forums** – Gearslutz, The Gear Page, or dedicated guitar forums. | Using multiple channels widens exposure; consignment shops handle shipping and payment for you. | | **6. Set Shipping & Payment Options** | • Offer local pickup if possible.
• For shipping, use a sturdy case or padded box, insure the package, and ship via USPS Priority Mail or UPS Ground.
• Accept PayPal, Venmo, or direct bank transfer. | Clear shipping terms protect both parties; insurance covers loss/damage. | | **7. Negotiate Wisely** | Be prepared to negotiate but know your lowest acceptable price. | Flexibility can close a deal faster, but staying firm protects your bottom line. | | **8. Finalize the Sale** | Once a buyer agrees, confirm payment, ship promptly, and provide tracking. | Prompt delivery and good communication lead to positive feedback and repeat buyers. | ### Quick Tips - **Highlight Unique Features** – If your guitar has custom finishes, inlays, or a special history, mention them. - **Mention Any Repairs** – If you’ve had a new bridge or neck adjustment, disclose it. - **Use “For Sale” Tags** – If you’re posting in a physical store or community board, a clear sign attracts attention. - **Safety First** – When meeting buyers in person, choose a public place and consider bringing a friend. ### Example Listing > **Title:** 2010 Yamaha FG800 Acoustic Guitar – Excellent Condition > **Description:** > • Brand/Model: Yamaha FG800 > • Year: 2010 > • Serial #: 12345678 > • Condition: No cracks, minor fret wear, new strings installed. > • Accessories: Original case, strap, and a set of D’Addario strings. > • Price: $350 (negotiable). > • Shipping: Will ship via USPS Priority Mail with insurance. > • Local pickup available in the [Your City] area. > **Photos:** [Attach 5–6 high‑resolution images] > **Contact:** Email me at example@email.com or text 555‑123‑4567. Feel free to adapt this template to your guitar’s specifics. Good luck with your sale!
